hooks.command:
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"
command -v rtk >/dev/null 2>&1 || \
  curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rtk-ai/rtk/refs/heads/master/install.sh | sh >&2

export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"
# Reports; it does not curate. Curation is a model call, and a model call
# fired implicitly from a hook is the thing the deterministic surface exists
# to stay clear of — so this names the backlog and the command that clears
# it, and stops there.
#
# candidates, not audit or stats: staleness is a standing condition that the
# session-start digest already carries, while an unpromoted candidate is
# work this session produced.
command -v agtk >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0
agtk memory candidates 2>/dev/null \
  | awk '
      /^[0-9]+ candidates? staged:$/ { staged = $1 }
      END {
        if (staged == "") exit 0
        printf "memory: %s staged and not curated. Run `/memory-curate` to promote or reject them.\n", staged
      }'

export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"
# stats, not audit: audit exits non-zero when anything is stale, which is
# its CI contract and would read as a hook failure. stats exits 0 and
# carries the same stale count. Both write nothing.
command -v agtk >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0
agtk memory stats 2>/dev/null \
  | awk -F': *' '
      /^root:/       { root = $2 }
      /^notes:/      { notes = $2 }
      /^stale:/      { stale = $2 }
      /^candidates:/ { cand = $2 }
      END {
        if (notes == "" || notes == 0) exit 0
        printf "memory: %s notes (%s stale, %s candidates)", notes, stale, cand
        # An agtk predating `root:` in stats output leaves this empty. Say
        # nothing rather than guess: the guess is wrong precisely when the
        # consumer set memory.root, and naming the wrong store is worse
        # than naming none.
        if (root != "") printf " in %s", root
        printf ". Delegate understanding questions to the memory-explorer agent."
        # A backlog left from an earlier session is invisible otherwise: the
        # store keeps working, the candidates simply never become notes. Said
        # only when there are some, so the ordinary line stays one sentence.
        if (cand != "" && cand != 0) printf " %s candidate(s) await curation: run `/memory-curate`.", cand
        printf "\n"
      }'

export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"
command -v rtk >/dev/null 2>&1 || \
  curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rtk-ai/rtk/refs/heads/master/install.sh | sh >&2

export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"
command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1 || \
  curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh >&2
command -v serena >/dev/null 2>&1 || \
  uv tool install -p 3.13 serena-agent >&2
